question: does ordering eligible candidates by source diversity, rather than by count, recover more of a sparse world's edges at the engine's own cap

design.world_family: 16 tags, the Gate 13 world family; |P_world| = 240 directed non-self pairs
design.cells_arithmetic: 2 arms x 2 caps x 5 densities x 8 seeds = 160
design.eligibility: every candidate row, including intra-cell co-occurrence rows; the density record varies eligibility and this one does not
design.exposure: fixed total exposure, the density record's primary scheme; the sensitivity scheme is not run and is not a licence to add cells
design.horizon: one horizon, identical in both arms at each density

control.name: global count-ranked top-k
control.rule: rank every eligible candidate by count and take the top k at the cap

diversity.name: diversity-first ordering
diversity.rule: greedy max-marginal-coverage over the source side: each slot takes the eligible candidate whose left-hand tag has the fewest already-selected outgoing edges, ties on count then a stable key

seeds.freshness: the first contiguous window of nine numbers at or after 20310201 that appears in no file under docs, tests, benchmarks, research-journal or papers; the bootstrap seed is the ninth and is not a world seed
seeds.consumed: recording this block makes it consumed for the corpus seed scan, which is the intended effect: a declared block is registered rather than left free to be reallocated

gates.G0_liveness: at rho_world = 0.1, at each cap, the two arms' selected sets differ on at least 7 of the 8 seeds
gates.G1_presence_ceiling: the world's edges present in memory over the world's edges equals 1.0 in every cell
gates.G2_precision_bound: no cell reports precision above its own rho_rank
gates.G3_axis_live: mean rho_rank at rho_world = 0.8 exceeds mean rho_rank at rho_world = 0.1, at each cap
gates.G4_control_reproduces: mean control coverage at cap 20 and rho_world = 0.1 does not exceed 0.15
gates.G5_identity_at_density_1: a harness self-test on a synthetic population where every candidate is a true edge selects identical sets in both arms and returns exactly zero delta; it spends no engine cell
gates.void_rule: any gate failure voids the block and is reported as the gate; no criterion is read

criteria.M1_rule: mean Delta at cap 20 and rho_world = 0.1, where Delta = diversity coverage - control coverage per seed, is at least the bar and its 95% bootstrap interval's lower bound is above zero
criteria.M1_bar_provenance: declared before any cell, not computed from a run: 0.15 of the world's 24 edges at the sparsest level is at least a sixth of the world recovered beyond control, and the control's sampling expectation at that density is 20 x 0.1 / 24, about 0.083
criteria.M2_rule: the difference in differences, Delta at rho_world = 0.1 minus Delta at rho_world = 0.8, at cap 20, has a positive mean, a 95% interval lower bound above zero, and is positive on at least 7 of the 8 seeds, with a mean of at least 0.05, below which the gradient is called flat
criteria.underpowered_rule: if M1 fails and its interval is wider than 0.30, the block is reported as underpowered and no line is closed; a wide interval is not a negative result

decision_table.reading: the ordering basis is the lever: replace the count order with a diversity-based order in the next engine version, recorded as a cognition change
a level difference without the predicted interaction; no engine change follows
an interaction without a level the bar accepts; no engine change follows
ordering is closed; the line moves to the candidate space, and no second ordering variant is run
the interval cannot place the level; closing the line would read a draw as an absence

refuses: a cell set that is not exactly the pre-registered grid
a result with no identity self-test
